objective: Define the smallest future implementation boundary that may bridge reviewed native parser metadata and direct-launch handoff readiness into the existing sidecar launcher after the accepted direct_launch_handoff_failure run, while keeping this gate definition-only.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted source run still did not enter the sidecar launcher from the Verilator-facing process. This gate only defines the bridge boundary; it does not implement launch, run compare, or prove native-path execution.
reason: the previous review accepted direct_launch_handoff_failure as honest evidence
patched parser success and handoff fixture readiness are necessary but insufficient
the next useful step is to constrain the launcher bridge before changing code
coverage_output_equivalence remains the only scoped correctness policy

failure_class_boundary.process_parse_failure: the Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before the expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: native parser output exists but target/template/shape/source context is missing or ambiguous
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_authority_failure: reviewed handoff or stage authority is absent or mismatched for pulp_ita_mha 64x1
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_launcher_bridge_failure: validated native metadata and reviewed handoff readiness exist, but the bridge cannot enter the existing sidecar launcher
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the sidecar launcher is reached, but a scoped build/run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_sidecar_launcher_bridge_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the bridge boundary is narrow enough to review before implementation
whether the future implementation may stay inside existing importable tooling without adding a public CLI
whether sidecar_launcher_bridge_failure is a clearer next failure class than reusing direct_launch_handoff_failure after fixture readiness
whether the future run remains scoped to pulp_ita_mha 64x1 and coverage_output_equivalence
whether timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain non-claims
must_not_claim: direct Verilator sidecar execution by this definition

non_claims: not broad native Verilator option support
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
